fusions.name: Link to Link
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 3 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of that. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Fetter Break
fusions.desc: Snaps the chain that holds you, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and ignores their resistances. Your movement speed rises 25% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Staked Out
fusions.desc: Stakes a chained wolf to the ground for 16 seconds. Every 1.4 seconds it bites an enemy within 3.5 tiles for 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Next in Line
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a packmate leaps at the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage, then leaps on to 2 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 4 seconds.
